## 1、**DC08PE12**创建有向图的邻接数组存储结构

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status CreateDG(MGraph &G, VexType *vexs, int n,
                           ArcInfo *arcs, int e) 
{    // Add your code here
    InitGraph(G,DG,n);
    G.n=n;
    G.e=e;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        G.vexs[i]=vexs[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
            ArcCell *info=(ArcCell*)malloc(sizeof(ArcCell));
            info->adj=0;
            info->info=NULL;
            G.arcs[i][u]=*info;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < e; i++) {
        char start=arcs[i].v;
        char end=arcs[i].w;

        int startIndex=LocateVex(G,start);
        int endIndex=LocateVex(G,end);
       
        G.arcs[startIndex][endIndex].adj=1;
    }

    return OK;


}
```

## 2、**DC08PE15**在图G中，相对于k顶点的当前邻接顶点m，求下一个邻接顶点。

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int NextAdjVex(MGraph G, int k, int m) 
{   // Add your code here
    if (m>=G.n-1) {
        return -1;
    }

    for (int i = m+1; i < G.n; i++) {
        ArcCell target=G.arcs[k][i];

        if (target.adj==1) {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return -1;
    
}
```

## 3、**DC08PE22**计算以邻接表方式存储的有向图G中某顶点的入度

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int inDegree(ALGraph G, int k) 
{   // Add your code here
    if (G.n==0||G.e==0) {
        return -1;
    }
    int count=0;

    for (int i = 0; i < G.n; i++) {
        VexNode target=G.vexs[i];
        AdjVexNode *start=target.firstArc;

        while (start!=NULL) {
            int targetIndex=start->adjvex;
            if (targetIndex==k) {
                count++;
                break;
            }
            
            start=start->next;
        }
    }


    return count;

}
```

## 4、**DC08PE32**创建有向图的邻接表存储结构

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status CreateDG(ALGraph &G, VexType *vexs, int n,
                            ArcInfo *arcs, int e) 
{  // Add your code here
    G.n=n;
    G.e=e;
    if (n==0||e==0) {
        return ERROR;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char target=vexs[i];
        VexNode *start=(VexNode *)malloc(sizeof(VexNode));
        start->data=target;
        start->firstArc=NULL;
        G.vexs[i]=*start;
        AdjVexNode *info;

        for (int u = 0; u < e; u++) {
            if (arcs[u].v==target) {
                char end=arcs[u].w;
                AdjVexNode *now=(AdjVexNode*)malloc(sizeof(AdjVexNode));
                now->adjvex=u;
                now->next=NULL;
                if (start->firstArc==NULL) {
                    start->firstArc=now;
                    info=now;
                }else {
                    info->next=now;
                }

            }
        }
    }

    return OK;


}
```
